text: Oh my God... Nate? Nate! It's you, it's really you!
I looked everywhere. I didn't think I'd ever see your face again.
We're together again. That's all that matters, honey. We can find Shaun together, just like we planned.
Yes, it's me! Why are you looking at me like that?
Who am I? Honey, it's me. It's Nora.
Seeing... what? What's that supposed to mean?
I... I walked. I don't really remember. Does it matter? I'm here now.
Get away from him.
Excuse me? Who do you think you...
...No. No, that's not...
Who are you? No. What are you?
I'm Nora. I'm his wife. I don't know who you are, or what kind of sick joke this is.
I'm his wife. I was in that pod. I've been standing next to him for weeks.
That's a lie. I was in that pod. I remember the cold. I remember the man with the scar. I remember... being shot.
So do I.
Then you're the copy. You have to be. Nate, tell her!
I can't breathe... I can't... okay. Okay.
Don't say that. Please don't say that to me.
This isn't funny, Nate. None of this is funny.
Prove it? I... yes. Yes, I can prove it.
Vault 111. Take me back to the vault. My pod is there. I'll show you where it happened. I'll show you both.
Hon, that thing is wearing my face and saying my words. You want to take it home?
I'm not a thing.
I think we keep it where we can see it. Fine. The vault.
Thank you. You'll see. Both of you will see.
It walks in front of me.
Settlement? What settlement? I've been searching for you since I woke up.
Of course. Anywhere. As long as I'm with you.
Nate... who is that? Why does she... why does she look like me?
No. No, no, no. That's not possible.
I'm fine. I'm fine. I'll be fine when we get to the vault.
I keep going over that morning. The coffee, the news. Codsworth. Shaun crying. I remember all of it. Why would I remember all of it if it wasn't mine?
Every time I close my eyes I'm back in that pod. Is that normal? Tell me that's normal.
She looks at me like I'm something on the bottom of her shoe. My own face, looking at me like that.
Can we walk faster? I need to see it. I need you to see it.
Vault 111 is north of Sanctuary. Up the hill. I know the way. Of course I know the way.
What if she's right? ...No. No.
I can feel my heartbeat. Real people have heartbeats.
I remember our wedding. The rain. You dropped the ring.
Why can't I remember waking up?
Remind me again why we're escorting an Institute machine to our front door.
It even fidgets like me. That's the worst part.
When we get to the vault, it's going to see an empty pod. My empty pod. And then what?
I keep waiting for it to slip up. It doesn't.
Don't let it walk behind you, hon.
Do you remember the blue dress? The one with the buttons?
It was green.
...It was green.
You don't have to keep staring at me.
Someone has to.
What did you study? At law school?
You tell me.
...Contracts. You hated contracts. I hated contracts.
Don't.
Here. Here it is. This is where they put us.
That one's yours, honey. And this one... this is mine.
It's empty. Of course it's empty, I'm right here. See? I told you.
It's empty because I climbed out of it.
The door opened. I was bleeding. I fell on the floor right there. I found stimpaks in the overseer's office, and I sat against that wall until I could stand.
So tell me. How did you get out?
I... I got out. I walked out. I...
I remember the cold. I remember the shot. And then I'm in Diamond City. There's nothing in between. Why is there nothing in between?
Nate. Nate, why can't I remember?
No... no, no, no. She's real. She's the real one. She's been with you this whole time.
Then what am I? Somebody built me. Somebody made me remember my baby.
I'm not anybody. I'm a recording of somebody.
Hon. Over here a second.
I don't like this. I don't like it. I don't know what the Institute wants with a copy of me, and that scares the hell out of me.
But look at her. That isn't an act. Whatever she is, she's hurting.
I think she should come with us. If nothing else, so we can keep an eye on her.
It's your call, though. It always is.
So. What happens to me now?
You mean it? You... thank you. Thank you, thank you. I'll be useful, I promise. You won't regret it.
All right. Let's go. On your feet.
...Thank you. Both of you.
I understand. I'd need time too. I'll be here. I don't really have anywhere else.
Fair enough. We'll come back.
Nate... Fine. Let's get this over with.
Maybe I'm not the original. But I'm a person! I'm a person!
That's that.
Can we get out of here now? Please.
Please. Please don't do this. I won't get in the way, I won't say a word, I'll just... please.
Please reconsider.
Good riddance.
...Okay.
She went after them. On her own.
Connie Abernathy. That's where you found me, hon. She was trying to protect the place we found each other again.
...She really did think like me.
I sent her away. "Good riddance." That's what I said.
